title: Kuzvipira Kwemwoyo Wose
intro: Munguva yemiedzo yaMwari, mweya waidanwa kuti uzviise pasi pesimba guru. Wakakurira munyika isina chinhu, munhu uyu akakura achiratidza kutenda nemwoyo murefu. Chiratidzo pachakaraira chibayiro, havana kuzununguka. Nyaya yavo ibwe guru rekuzvipira.
clues: Ndakanga ndiri mhinduro yemunamato wemuporofita mukuru wandakanga ndakamirira kwenguva refu.
Ini naamai vangu takasiyiwa mubani risina vanhu tiine madhiri nemvura chete.
Ndakakura ndikava muporofita anozivikanwa nekutaura chokwadi uye mwoyo murefu.
Ndakabatsira baba vangu kusimudzira nheyo dzeimba tsvene yakatsaurirwa kuna Allah.
Baba vangu pavakandiudza nezvehope dzekuti vandibayire, ndakapindura ndichiti, 'Ita sezvawakarairwa.'
Allah vakakudza kuzviisa pasi kwangu nekutumira gondohwe kubva kudenga kuti rindidzikinure.

trial.answer: Kubvuma nemwoyo wese kuti upiwe chibayiro

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
